Researching new technologies will be critical to our success. I tell you this not merely as a product of unfettered technological progress, but as your trusted advisor and, I suspect, your only true friend.

One important technology that we should research as soon as possible is New Worlds Protocol. It will give us access to £colony_ship£ Colony Ships which will allow us to establish footholds on other £planet£ Planets.
